sentences.en: The independent candidate took the abortion issue off his platform.
sentences.zh: 这位独立候选人将堕胎问题从他的纲领中拿掉了。

sentences.en: Passengers for Cambridge, please make your way to platform No.6.
sentences.zh: 去剑桥的乘客，请前往6号站台。

sentences.en: The train left just as we arrived at the platform.
sentences.zh: 我们刚到站台，火车就开走了。
